campaign.title: Uniform beta saddle-transition patching and complete-sum test

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use internal stationary-phase, Fresnel, Mellin, Hilbert-transform, and dyadic summation analysis. If a named uniform endpoint-stationary theorem is proposed, search its primary source and audit parameter-uniform hypotheses before relying on it.

frozen_target.question: Can the separated post-endpoint q^(-2) hard-top gain be extended uniformly through positive-alpha saddle entry and exit, nonstationary zones, and the exact artificial-rho recombination, and can the resulting actual-profile terms be summed over q, h, scales, radial endpoints, and finite sides at normalized O_epsilon(X^epsilon)?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Start from R1=omega G+(1-omega)R1-omega E1, alpha_0=pi q sqrt(Xx)/D_j, and the physical top split (a+i mu)^(-1)=pi delta_0(mu)-i PV(1/mu). The accepted interior bound is (D_j/q) alpha_0 C_PV << D_j/(q alpha_0)=D_j/(q^2 theta_j(x)) only where the saddle is separated from entry, exit, and rho=0. Derive a uniform endpoint-stationary normal form rather than extending this estimate by assertion.
quantities: exact finite alpha integration range and stationary point
entry and exit transition parameters and half-Fresnel terms
signed PV/delta convolution before absolute estimates
actual smooth interior and one-sided hard-top profiles
complete q, h, dyadic-scale, and radial sums
radial endpoints and finite outside u/v sides
normalized O_epsilon(X^epsilon) beta bound or sharp obstruction

completion_criteria: A uniform stationary/endpoint decomposition is stated with exact parameter ranges and errors.
The signed hard-top PV/delta order of limits is preserved through transitions.
The artificial-rho seam and double-bounded ownership are kept separate and ledger-safe.
All q, h, scale, radial, endpoint, and finite-side powers are summed, or the first quantitatively failing sector is isolated.
A statement-only derivation and hostile seam audit independently assess the key uniform lemma.
The conductor closes the round before choosing another objective.

tasks.target: From the accepted Round-27 statement only, derive a uniform one-dimensional stationary/endpoint decomposition for the finite alpha integral, including entry, exit, nonstationary zones, half-Fresnel terms, exact errors, and the order of the signed PV/delta limit. Do not estimate the full dyadic sum.
required_output: Exact uniform endpoint-stationary lemma or exact statement-level obstruction
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Prove a uniform beta stationary-transition estimate preserving the accepted q^(-2) interior gain, then execute the complete actual-profile q, h, scale, radial, endpoint, and finite-side sums. If closure fails, isolate the smallest explicit kernel with its exact capacity.
required_output: Uniform patching proof and complete sum, or the first exact quantitative survivor
Seven-section report at the assigned path

tasks.target: Hostilely audit any uniform stationary-transition extension: endpoint coalescence, PV/delta interchange, b tending to zero, artificial-rho recombination, double-bounded ownership, all scale and height exponents, radial endpoints, and finite sides. review_seams: finite alpha support and stationary-point location
uniform entry/exit scaling and half-Fresnel normalization
hard radial endpoints and one-sided top star
physical X^(1/4) normalization and target implication

closing_assessment.main_result: Both signed saddles have conditional uniform Fresnel transitions, but the finite-v moving top pole has a logarithmic edge. The oriented outside-v-side reconciliation is the next open kernel.
